findings.title: traceID no longer logged in plugin request log
findings.body: The explicit `traceID` field (previously derived via tracing.TraceIDFromContext) was removed from logParams. The new code relies on `m.logger.FromContext(ctx)` to supply contextual attributes. The contextual logger middleware only adds endpoint, pluginId, dsName, dsUID and uname, and nothing visible adds traceID. If the infra logger's FromContext does not inject the trace ID, the `Plugin Request Completed` logs lose trace correlation, which is a regression.

findings.title: FromContext fallback drops logger context
findings.body: When the type assertion to *log.ConcreteLogger fails, the code returns `d.New()`. That is a fresh wrapper, so it silently loses contextual attributes. The wrapped logger is always a ConcreteLogger, so the branch is mostly dead, but if it ever runs the attributes disappear without any warning.

findings.title: Helper name and endpoint attributes not set for stream calls
findings.body: The helper is still named `instrumentContext`, which is inconsistent with the rename. The stream methods (SubscribeStream, PublishStream, RunStream) pass the context through without adding a logger, which matches the previous behavior but is worth noting.
